name: ADK Financial Advisor
description: Multi-agent ADK sample that researches a stock ticker, proposes trading strategies, plans execution and assesses risk for an advisor.
whatItDoes: Aimed at human financial advisors, it walks through analysing a ticker, generating strategies that fit a stated risk appetite and horizon, drafting an execution plan and evaluating overall risk. It is for education and demonstration, not real advice.
howItWorks: A coordinator agent delegates to data-analyst, trading-analyst, execution and risk sub-agents in sequence; the data analyst gathers market information through Google Search. It runs through the ADK CLI or web UI on Vertex AI and can be deployed to Agent Engine.
